notes:
CRM notes and call highlights:
- Use-case: centralized research portal for PMs + analysts. Primary flows: (1) semantic doc search, (2) reranking of candidate passages, (3) generation of research summaries.
- Prefer Dedicated capacity: predictable latency under heavy nightly indexing and peak morning usage (08:30-10:30 ET). Quote: 'We can't have unpredictable p95 spikes during market open' (Head of Research).
- Data residency: global presence but must keep EU customer data in EU data centers. KMS: customer-managed keys (KMIP or AWS KMS with key policies).
- SE notes: planning hybrid deployment - Redwood Private control plane with Dedicated GPU pools in customer VPC for sensitive datasets. Suggested autoscaling floor + burst.
- Reranking approach: two-stage pipeline: candidate retrieval (vector search) -> lightweight model rerank on GPU (low-latency). Need kernel/quantization guidance for 8-bit reranker to reduce cost.
- Cost sensitivity: finance ops asked for 12-18 month ROI model; will evaluate token/unit pricing vs current in-house vector infra.
- Quote from CTO: 'If dedicated gives predictable p95 and a clear path for KMS + residency, procurement is much easier.'
- Documents linked: pricing deck, security FAQ, perf benchmark CSV stub.
- Open ask: provide sample Dedicated node sizing for 200 QPS search+rerank with cost estimate and expected p95 numbers across seq lengths.
- POC success criteria: p95 < 400ms end-to-end for target queries; index ingests at >=10k docs/hour; KMS integration validated in staging.
procurement_notes: Procurement engaged; legal wants Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with EU residency clause. Finance requesting 12-month minimum committed spend estimate and failure SLA credits.
